en:
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a giant machine... I've never seen
this before. What could this—

IF-YOU'VE-COME-THIS-FAR...THAT-MEANS-
YOU-SOLVED-THE-PAINTING-PUZZLE...
EXCELLENT...TEAMWORK.
Huh? What teamwork? It's just Shuichi.

THAT-PUZZLE-WAS-TOO-DIFFICULT-FOR-
ONE-PERSON-TO-SOLVE.

I'M-SURE...THEY-GOT-ALONG-AND-SOLVED-
IT-TOGETHER.

L-Let's just play along... We'll put ourselves
in danger if we defy him.

It's true what they say—the serious ones
are the scariest when they finally snap.
I'M-CERTAIN-IT'S-NOT-POSSIBLE...

BUT-DID-THAT-OUTDATED-PIECE-OF-JUNK-
HELP-YOU-AT-ALL?
Oh, yes... We should explain this room.
So this is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>computer room<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
<CLT=cltMIND>Computer room?

But this computer isn't just some ordinary
computer.

This computer you're lookin' at is, like...
super amazing.

If I remember correctly...it's so amazing, you
can even use it to create a <CLT=cltSTRONG>new world<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
A "new world"?

Yeah, a new world! You can use this to
create a new world!

...Wait, were we supposed to tell him that?
I've already forgotten the plan.
You totally said way too much.
Wahhhh! I knew it!

You're so forgetful, Monotaro! You gotta try
to remember what you can and can't say!
S-Sorry...
...WHY-DIDN'T-YOU-HELP-HIM, MONOPHANIE?
Huh?

WHEN-YOU-REALIZED-HE-WAS-SAYING-TOO-
MUCH, YOU-COULD'VE-HELPED-HIM, RIGHT?
SO-WHY-DIDN'T-YOU?

YOU'RE-FRIENDS, RIGHT?
SO-WHY-DIDN'T-YOU-HELP-HIM?
Uh, um...well...um...

IF-YOU-CAN'T-GET-ALONG...
YOU-WILL-BE-PUNISHED.

YOU-TOO, MONOTARO. FRIENDS-SHARE-
EVERYTHING...EVEN-PUNISHMENTS.
What!? Backfire!

<CLT=cltMIND>This machine can make a new world...
What are they talking about?

I'm not good with computers...I don't think I'd
understand it no matter how much I investigate.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll investigate around here a little more.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a giant green computer
in the middle of the room.

This machine can make a new world...
What could that mean?

<CLT=cltMIND>With how little I know about computers,
I don't think I stand a chance.

I guess...I have no choice but to leave
it be for now.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a giant green computer
in the middle of the room.

This machine can make a new world...
What could that mean?

<CLT=cltMIND>With the little I know about computers,
I don't think I stand a chance.

I guess...I have no choice but to leave
it be for now.
<CLT=cltMIND>Ah! A treasure chest!
<CLT=cltMIND>I opened the chest eagerly, and...

I found one...
A <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

<CLT=cltMIND>With this...I can find out what this place
is, why we're here...
<CLT=cltMIND>But, before that...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's the treasure chest that had
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltMIND> inside.

<CLT=cltMIND>With this...I can find out what this place
is, why we're here...
<CLT=cltMIND>But, before that...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's the treasure chest that had
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltMIND> inside.

<CLT=cltMIND>With this...I can find out what this place
is, why we're here...
<CLT=cltMIND>But, before that...
Oh! You found the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

Wooow! You're pretty dependable, despite
that lame face of yours! I respect that.
Y-Yeah...

I'll get the others. You just bring that to the
dining hall, Shuichi.
Welp, off I go! See yaaaaaaa!

<CLT=cltMIND>He chatted away, and I couldn't get a
word in edgewise. He left, waving goodbye.
<CLT=cltMIND>But, before that...
